== frame tilde cursor=3,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo ~ ~/sub ~x
|<HOME> <HOME>/sub ~x
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame variables cursor=8,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo ~ ~/sub ~x
|<HOME> <HOME>/sub ~x
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set NAME world
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo hello-$NAME ${NAME} $NAME-x $NOPE| cat
|hello-world world world-x
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 set
@5 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@5 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame arithmetic cursor=11,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo ~ ~/sub ~x
|<HOME> <HOME>/sub ~x
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ set NAME world
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo hello-$NAME ${NAME} $NAME-x $NOPE| cat
|hello-world world world-x
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $((1 + 2 * 3)) $(( (1+2) * 3 ))
|7 9
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@3 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@3 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 set
@5 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@5 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@11 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
